explanation: At time 4 tasks 1 and 3 tie on processing time; index 1 goes first.
The CPU is idle from 10 to 20.
Identical tasks run in index order.
Tasks 1 and 2 arrive exactly when task 0 finishes at 3.
A short task arriving while the CPU is busy does not preempt.
Input is not sorted by enqueue time.
All tasks arrive early: the available set grows to thousands.
Lots of ties on processing time.
